verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports scale features like a Dockerized FastAPI server, browser pool monitoring, multi-URL batch configs, proxy/retry chains, and checkpoint resume—indicating built-in support for concurrent, large-scale crawling. However, community feedback notes that production-grade reliability (rate limiting, bot mitigation, session handling) still requires the user to build their own policy layer, suggesting the scaling story works but with real operational caveats.
